title: Your computer checks in less when nothing waits
summary: The Trillion helper on your computer hears about new work as it arrives, and looks over everything less often when nothing is waiting.

payload.title: Quieter when nothing waits
payload.body: Your computer used to go over every waiting job every ten minutes, even when nothing had changed. New work still reaches it the moment it arrives; when a check finds nothing to do, the next one waits longer, up to an hour, so your account stays quick.
